title: 第一卷 第7章 不会重蹈覆辙
novel_title: 重回九八：我在小渔村兴风作浪
content_zh:
李华走到老陈摊位前，比了个中指。

    这可把老陈气得半死。

    好处没占到，还惹了一身腥。

    张海洋乐得不行，但想了想，走过去给老陈递了根烟，不管咋说，这次他都算是抢了老陈的生意，都一个村的，还在一起做生意，面上不好闹得太难看。

    “海洋，这次我不和你计较，反正你和那烂仔也做不了长远生意的。”

    “听叔的一句劝，你还年轻，把握不住，和那种烂仔还是要少打交道为妙。”

    “嗯。”

    张海洋点点头，心里却是不以为然。

    万一呢。

    他倒是觉得李华这人，没大家口中的那么烂。

    ……

    走在回家的路上，李华饶有兴趣的打量着四周，觉得一切熟悉又陌生。

    熟悉的是，眼前破破烂烂的景象，和他记忆里的印象大差不差。

    陌生的是，在未来，脚下的土路通通变成水泥路，现在随处可见的石头房子，未来都成了砖瓦房和民宿小洋房。

    如今的小渔村，未来却成了远近闻名的旅游圣地。

    上一世。

    村子变得再好，也和他无关。

    但现在不一样了，他在心里暗自定了个小目标，不要辜负了重生的机会，趁着村子还没发展，想方设法抓住时代的浪潮积累资本。

    正计划着，耳边传来刘表的话：“华哥，你现在有钱了，晚上组个局。”

    “咱们可以打得大一点。”

    “没准你能赢出来明天还张大雷的钱。”

    他心里打着如意算盘，以李华的凑运气和烂牌技，这些钱，他准能全部赢走。

    李华冷着脸说道：“不了，以后我都不玩牌了。”

    上一世，他就是跟着刘表这狗东西混在一起，抽烟打牌，不干正事，每次打牌都被坑，还傻逼兮兮地把人当兄弟。

    刘表一愣，然后伸手要和李华勾肩搭背：“华哥，莫开玩笑喽。”

    李华推开他：“谁和你开玩笑了。”

    “我他妈的和黄赌毒不共戴天。”

    “以后你要打牌就找别人。”

    刘表傻眼，还是不死心，劝说道：“华哥，你输了那么多钱，就不想着翻本吗？”

    李华抓住他的衣领，拎起来，骂道：“再撺掇我打牌，别怪我不客气。”

    “滚蛋。”

    说完，猛地一甩，把刘表甩倒在地上。

    刘表从地上爬起来，也来了火气：“李华，你这就过分了吧。”
content_en:
Li Hua walked to Lao Chen's stall and showed his middle finger.

    This made Lao Chen half angry to death.

    I didn't get the benefits, but I also made a mess.

    Zhang Haiyang was very happy, but after thinking about it, he walked over and handed Lao Chen a cigarette. No matter how you put it, this time he was stealing Lao Chen's business. They were from the same village and they were still doing business together. It was too ugly to make a fuss.

    "Hayang, I won't argue with you this time. You and that bastard can't do long-term business anyway."

    "Listen to my uncle's advice. You're still young and can't handle it. It's better to have less contact with that kind of bad boy."

    "Yeah."

    Zhang Haiyang nodded, but he didn't agree in his heart.

    What if.

    He actually felt that Li Hua was not as bad as everyone said.

    …

    On the way home, Li Hua looked around with interest, feeling that everything was familiar yet strange.

    What was familiar was that the shabby scene in front of him was very different from the impression in his memory.

    What is strange is that in the future, the dirt roads under our feet will all turn into concrete roads. The stone houses that can be seen everywhere now will become brick houses and small B&B bungalows in the future.

    Today's small fishing village will become a famous tourist destination in the future.

    Previous life.

    No matter how good the village becomes, it has nothing to do with him.

    But things are different now. He secretly set a small goal in his heart, not to let down the opportunity of rebirth, and to find ways to seize the wave of the times and accumulate capital while the village has not yet developed.

    Just as he was planning, Liu Biao's words came to his ears: "Brother Hua, you have money now, set up a game tonight."

    "We can fight a little bigger."

    "Maybe you can win the money to pay Zhang Dalei tomorrow."

    He was thinking that with Li Hua's luck and bad poker skills, he would be able to win all the money.

    Li Hua said with a cold face: "No, I won't play cards anymore."

    In his last life, he just hung out with that bitch like Liu Biao, smoking and playing cards instead of doing serious business. He was cheated every time he played cards, and he stupidly treated people as brothers.

    Liu Biao was stunned for a moment, then reached out to hook up with Li Hua: "Brother Hua, don't be joking."

    Li Hua pushed him away: "Who are you kidding?"

    "I'm damn incompatible with pornography, gambling and drugs."

    "If you want to play cards from now on, just find someone else."

    Liu Biao was dumbfounded, but still refused to give up, and persuaded him: "Brother Hua, you have lost so much money, don't you want to make up your money?"

    Li Hua grabbed his collar, picked him up, and cursed: "Don't blame me for being rude if you encourage me to play cards again."

    "Get lost."

    After saying that, he swung Liu Biao to the ground.

    Liu Biao got up from the ground and became angry: "Li Hua, you have gone too far."
title_en: Volume 1 Chapter 7 I won’t repeat the same mistakes
